mapper.sql:
FROM member_task_completion c LEFT JOIN member_task_reward_grant g ON g.completion_id = c.completion_id AND g.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.task_id = #{taskId} AND c.voided = 0
AND g.status = 'granted'
AND g.status = 'failed'
mapper.select:
SELECT c.completion_id AS completion_id, c.user_id AS user_id, c.completed_at AS completed_at, g.grant_id AS grant_id, g.status AS grant_status, g.error_message AS error_message
ORDER BY c.completion_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.sql: FROM member_task_completion c LEFT JOIN member_task_reward_grant g ON g.completion_id = c.completion_id AND g.company_id = c.company_id INNER JOIN member_task t ON t.task_id = c.task_id AND t.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.voided = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT c.completion_id AS completion_id, c.task_id AS task_id, c.completed_at AS completed_at, g.status AS grant_status, t.name AS task_name, t.type_category AS type_category, t.type_detail AS type_detail, t.reward_config AS reward_config
ORDER BY c.completed_at DESC, c.completion_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
